turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why did Owen find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
I didn't come here for compliments. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Flattery isn't an answer, Hale. What is the zero based on?
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
Blessing for what? You haven't told me what your way is. Trust needs something on paper, so show me what you have.
